comments.author: Nikolaj
comments.body: Can anyone explain me whats the diference between original and optional ship skill??Pls answer

comments.author: Curious
comments.body:
Optional skills are the skills that are available for the ship through mods. In other words, the skills you see above alongside the ship stats are the optional skills for the ship. Original skills are skills that you can add to the ship that aren't available to it through mods via Original Ship Permits, or OSP's. Most optional ship skills are available as an Original Skill though not all. Also keep in mind that you can only add up to one original skill to your ship.

One cool thing about Original Skills is that if you have one on your ship that you don't like, you can overwrite it with another original skill (which is NOT possible with optional skills since they are added through modding).

Now, if there is a skill you want to add to your ship but it isn't available as an optional skill on your ship and it's unavailable as an original skill as well, you CAN still add it via fusion.

comments.body:
